user.title: Connect to Lights3D
user.description: Enable the Home Assistant bridge in Lights3D (Settings → Remote), then enter this PC's address and token.

error.cannot_connect: Could not reach Lights3D. Is the bridge on, and is the host/port right?
error.invalid_auth: Token was rejected. Copy a fresh token from Lights3D Settings → Remote.

abort.already_configured: This Lights3D bridge is already configured.
